scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the invariant one-dimensional entropic congestion map and for initial conditions strictly between zero and one; off-diagonal game states are not considered.
At the critical parameter the reciprocal-square formulas exclude precisely the countable finite-time equilibrium preimage set.
The new cycle is uniquely determined for all supercritical parameters but only its birth amplitude is quantified; global stability outside the critical line is not classified.
A classical interval-map convergence theorem and standard parabolic asymptotic methods are explicitly credited. Independent scientific audit and independent validation have not been performed.
title: Global neutral-flip attraction and signed critical relaxation in an entropic congestion map
